desc.en: The campus "front door" on Military Trail, built over the footprint of the old 1970s gym and opened in stages from September 2018: registrar, admissions, classrooms, a lecture hall and an event centre.
desc.zh: Military Trail 边上的校园“正门”，建在 1970 年代旧体育馆的位置上，2018 年 9 月起分阶段启用：注册处、招生办、教室、阶梯教室和活动中心。

desc.en: The blue building beside Joan Foley Hall: residence offices and common space.
desc.zh: 琼·福利楼旁边那座蓝色的楼：宿舍办公室和公共空间。

desc.en: Suite-style residence opened in 2003: 58 suites for up to 229 students.
desc.zh: 2003 年启用的套间式宿舍：58 个套间，最多住 229 名学生。

desc.zh: 联排式学生宿舍，属于 UTSC 早期宿舍区第 2 期。联排宿舍都以树木命名。

desc.en: Arts and Crafts country house of the Miller Lash estate on Highland Creek, built about 1913–14. The university acquired the land in 1963; the 17-room house later served as the principal's residence and now hosts university events.
desc.zh: 米勒·拉什庄园的工艺美术风格乡间宅邸，位于 Highland Creek 河畔，约建于 1913–14 年。大学在 1963 年买下这片土地；这座 17 个房间的宅邸后来做过校长官邸，现在用于学校活动。

desc.en: Completed in 2005; home to the Principal's office.
desc.zh: 2005 年建成，校长办公室所在地。

desc.en: Non-profit child care centre on campus, opened in 1990.
desc.zh: 校内的非营利托儿中心，1990 年开办。

desc.en: Built for the 2015 Pan Am and Parapan Am Games and co-owned by the City of Toronto and U of T: two 50 m pools, a diving tank, a field house, a fitness centre and a climbing wall.
desc.zh: 为 2015 年泛美运动会和泛美残疾人运动会而建，由多伦多市和多伦多大学共同拥有：两个 50 米泳池、跳水池、室内田径场、健身中心和攀岩墙。

desc.en: Townhouse residence, phase 2 of UTSC's original residence village. Townhouses are named after trees.
desc.zh: 联排式学生宿舍，属于 UTSC 早期宿舍区第 2 期。联排宿舍都以树木命名。

desc.en: The copper-clad heart of the campus: the UTSC Library, a lecture theatre of about 500 seats, and the Doris McCarthy Gallery on the upper level.
desc.zh: 校园中心那座铜皮外墙的楼：UTSC 图书馆、约 500 座的阶梯教室，楼上是 Doris McCarthy 美术馆。

desc.en: Research laboratories and a lecture hall, opened in 2008 as an extension of the Science Wing.
desc.zh: 2008 年启用的科研实验楼，附设一间阶梯教室，是科学翼楼的扩建部分。

desc.en: Carriage house of the Miller Lash estate, built 1913–14 for Lash's cars.
desc.zh: 米勒·拉什庄园的马车房，1913–14 年建，用来停放拉什的汽车。

desc.en: Opened in 2004: the student union, food court, health and wellness centre, and prayer space.
desc.zh: 2004 年启用：学生会、美食广场、健康中心和祈祷室都在这里。

desc.en: Half of the Brutalist Andrews Building, the original Scarborough College (first classes 1965). Its "indoor streets" step down the edge of the Highland Creek ravine; the building has appeared in films such as Total Recall, Pacific Rim and The Shape of Water.
desc.zh: 粗野主义建筑安德鲁斯楼的一半，也是最初的士嘉堡学院（1965 年开课）。楼内的“室内街道”沿 Highland Creek 河谷边缘逐级下降；这座楼出现在《全面回忆》《环太平洋》《水形物语》等电影中。

desc.en: Grounds and maintenance building in the valley.
desc.zh: 河谷里的校园维护用房。

desc.en: Townhouse residence, phase 3 of UTSC's original residence village. Townhouses are named after trees.
desc.zh: 联排式学生宿舍，属于 UTSC 早期宿舍区第 3 期。联排宿舍都以树木命名。

desc.en: Completed in 1972 and named after Vincent Bladen. It once housed the library; the underground Hall of Excellence (1995) links it to the Humanities Wing.
desc.zh: 1972 年建成，以 Vincent Bladen 命名，曾是图书馆所在地；1995 年建成的地下通道 Hall of Excellence 把它与人文翼楼连在一起。

desc.en: The other half of the Andrews Building, joined to the Science Wing by the Meeting Place, a central atrium under a coffered concrete skylight.
desc.zh: 安德鲁斯楼的另一半，通过 Meeting Place 与科学翼楼相连——那是一个顶着混凝土格子天窗的中央中庭。

desc.en: Opened in 2004 as the Management Wing (MW), later the Social Sciences Building. In December 2023 it was renamed in Anishinaabemowin; Elder Josh Eshkawkogan proposed the name, often translated as "everyone, spirit, mind".
desc.zh: 2004 年作为管理翼楼（MW）启用，后来改称社会科学楼。2023 年 12 月改用阿尼什纳比语命名，名字由长老 Josh Eshkawkogan 提出，意为“众人·心灵·精神所在”。

desc.en: Townhouse residence, phase 3 of UTSC's original residence village. Townhouses are named after trees.
desc.zh: 联排式学生宿舍，属于 UTSC 早期宿舍区第 3 期。联排宿舍都以树木命名。

info.zh: 百年理工学院 Morningside 校区

desc.en: Centennial College's campus at 755 Morningside Avenue, inside the UTSC grounds; the two schools run joint programs.
desc.zh: 百年理工学院位于 Morningside Ave 755 号的校区，坐落在 UTSC 校园内；两校合办联合课程。

desc.en: Completed in summer 2015 for the Department of Physical & Environmental Sciences; the third building on the north campus.
desc.zh: 2015 年夏建成，物理与环境科学系所在地，是北校区的第三座楼。

desc.en: House in the valley next to the UTSC Tennis Centre.
desc.zh: 河谷里、UTSC 网球中心旁的小屋。

desc.en: Portable building.
desc.zh: 活动板房。

desc.en: Five storeys, planned as "Instructional Centre 2". In use since fall 2024 and formally opened in April 2025: 20 technology-enabled classrooms, the Department of Computer & Mathematical Sciences, the Sam Ibrahim Centre for Inclusive Excellence, and consolidated student services. Heated and cooled with geothermal energy.
desc.zh: 五层，原规划名“第二教学中心”。2024 年秋投入使用，2025 年 4 月正式揭幕：20 间智能教室、计算机与数学科学系、Sam Ibrahim 包容卓越中心，以及集中的学生服务。采用地热供暖制冷。

desc.en: Nine-storey residence with 746 beds and a dining hall, opened in September 2023. It is the largest building in Canada certified to the Passive House Classic standard.
desc.zh: 九层学生宿舍，746 个床位，带食堂，2023 年 9 月启用。它是加拿大获得“被动房 Classic”认证的最大建筑。

desc.en: Covered shed for the UTSC community bike-share program: 48 bikes, including cargo bikes.
desc.zh: UTSC 社区共享单车项目的车棚：48 个车位，包括载货自行车。

desc.en: The Myron and Berna Garron Health Sciences Complex, home of the Scarborough Academy of Medicine and Integrated Health. Six storeys and 32 m: anatomy lab, clinical skills lab, instructional labs and teaching clinics open to the public. The first cohorts (physician assistant, physiotherapy, nurse practitioner) arrived in fall 2026; the first 40 MD students start in 2027.
desc.zh: Myron 与 Berna Garron 健康科学综合楼，士嘉堡医学与综合健康学院（SAMIH）所在地。六层、32 米：解剖实验室、临床技能实验室、教学实验室，以及对公众开放的教学诊所。2026 年秋迎来首批医师助理、物理治疗和执业护士学生；首批 40 名医学博士（MD）学生 2027 年入学。

status.en: Open to students since fall 2026; exterior cladding being finished (Oct 2026).
status.zh: 2026 年秋已迎来学生；外立面收尾中（2026 年 10 月）。

info.arch: Formline Architecture + Urbanism, LGA Architectural Partners

desc.en: Opened on May 25, 2026. A two-storey, roughly 1,000 m² ovoid building wrapped in curved glulam timber, with circular gathering spaces at each end, a ramp lined with medicinal plants up to a viewing deck, and a sunken learning garden. A home for ceremony, teaching and student support.
desc.zh: 2026 年 5 月 25 日启用。两层、约 1000 平方米的椭圆形建筑，外覆弧形胶合木；两端是圆形聚会厅，一条种着药用植物的坡道通往观景平台，旁边有下沉式学习花园。用于仪式、教学和学生支持。

desc.en: A six-storey, 23.5 m parking structure with about 1,090 spaces (217 with EV chargers) over ground-floor shops, a new home for the campus bookstore, and Campus Safety and Parking Services. Built from June 2024 and designed to be adaptable to other uses later.
desc.zh: 六层、23.5 米的停车楼，约 1090 个车位（其中 217 个带电动车充电桩），底层是商铺、新的校园书店，以及校园安全与停车服务处。2024 年 6 月开工，设计上预留了日后改作他用的可能。

status.en: Parking open (Oct 2026); ground-floor shops opening soon.
status.zh: 停车场已开放（2026 年 10 月）；底层商铺即将开业。

desc.en: Completed in 2011 with funding from Canada's Economic Action Plan: lecture halls, classrooms and study space north of Ellesmere Road.
desc.zh: 2011 年建成，由加拿大经济行动计划资助：Ellesmere Road 以北的大小教室和自习空间。
